title: fix(console): Hide column in the column-header menu joins the list draft, like the View settings eye
body:
Part of #35955 — this PR builds the one acceptance item the coordinator's run found failing on the column-header menu; the card stays open for the spec half of item 5 (the view schema's `columnState` key), which needs `packages/spec` and is routed to #36403.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — measured on the built declarations: `ui/packages/types/dist/data-display.d.ts` gains `DataTableSchema.onColumnHide?: (columnKey: string) => void` (the zod mirror declares it as a by-name refusal, so the authored accept set does not widen), and `ui/packages/plugin-grid/dist/ObjectGrid.d.ts` gains the optional prop `onColumnHide?: (field: string) => void`; nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表用户在列头菜单里点「隐藏列」后，标签行右边会出现「放弃」「保存」，和在「视图设置」里点眼睛一样；以前列消失了却没有这两个按钮，只能刷新。
- 属于「列表页重做」专题里「列表上的改动都是临时的」那张卡，补上协调席验收时唯一没通过的一项。
- 出错时最坏是列头隐藏又回到以前的样子（列消失但没有按钮）；不写服务端、不动视图，撤回这个改动即可恢复原状。
- 无

## What changes

The coordinator's acceptance run on the card (comment 7070433857) failed one item: 「列头菜单里的「隐藏列」不出现「放弃」「保存」。列消失、没有写请求、刷新后恢复…同一个操作从「视图设置」里点眼睛就是好的。」

Measured on origin/main 3a81fb75: the column menu's "Hide column" (`hideColumn` in `data-table.tsx`) only filtered the table's own `columns` state and told nobody, so the list never heard of it and the draft store never saw it. The eye in View settings writes through `ListView`'s hide-fields writer (`updateListedFields`, then `onHiddenFieldsChange`), which the Console's `persistHiddenFields` turns into `listDraft.patch({ hiddenFields })`.

- `@object-ui/types`: a new runtime slot `DataTableSchema.onColumnHide(columnKey)`, refused by name on the zod mirror like `onColumnsReorder`; the mirror-parity ledger (`KnownDrift`, 51 entries / 92 keys), the declared-keys type pin and the handler-keys refusal census (`handler-keys-json-refusal-6124`: RUNTIME_SLOT row + KeepsFunction entry, 61 slots / 83 ids) carry it.
- `@object-ui/components` `data-table`: "Hide column" still hides the column in the table at once, and now also calls `schema.onColumnHide?.(columnKey)`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid`: a new optional host prop `onColumnHide(field)`, forwarded onto the data-table node (so the grouped grid's per-group tables carry it too).
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView`: hands the grid `onColumnHide`, which writes through the eye's own writer (`updateListedFields`): the host hears `onHiddenFieldsChange` with the whole hidden list, an added column leaves the reader's added fields instead of being hidden (as unticking it does), and a key that names no column the list draws reports nothing. No app-shell change: the Console's existing `persistHiddenFields` already puts that list in the draft, so Discard brings the column back and Save keeps it hidden on both save paths.

Not touched: `listDraftStore.ts`, `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (a parallel card is editing them), and `data-table.tsx` outside `hideColumn` (#36332 edits that file elsewhere; overlap-check clean against every open PR).

## Tests

- New: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.headerMenuHide-35955.test.tsx` — through the real `ObjectGrid` and `data-table`, opening a header's menu and picking "Hide column" calls the host's `onColumnHide` once with `'stage'` and the column goes; CONTROL: with no handler the column still goes.
- New block `ListView.headerMenuHide-35955` in the shared harness `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx` (four cases: reported as the eye does and the grid drops the column; adds to columns already hidden and a second hide of a hidden one reports nothing; an added column leaves the added fields; an unknown key reports nothing).
- Updated: `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (KnownDrift key set and header figure), `data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts` (declared + exact shape), `handler-keys-json-refusal-6124.test.ts` (RUNTIME_SLOT row, KeepsFunction entry, pins 60 → 61 and 82 → 83; da38b481).
- No test migrated, retired or rewritten.

<details><summary>Runs (head 47950b64 unless noted; final head da38b481 adds one test-only commit: handler-keys census + zod-mirror-parity + types type-check 385/385 passed, CI 47 success / 15 skipped / 0 failed)</summary>

- Locked build of the closure: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' build` — VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the new grid pin, the ListView harness, `zod-mirror-parity`, `data-table-declared-keys-6882` and `data-table-header-menu-35876` — Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 194 passed (194) (on 0df34362; the 6882 type pin is compile-time, judged by type-check below).
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check` — all four Done, VERDICT command-exit 0 (on 0df34362).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` on 47950b64 — clean; reverse leg: changing the declared member to `(columnKey: number) => void` turned it red at the new shape pin (`data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts`, TS2344 `Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'`), so the pin reads the declaration; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation A (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, src-resolved through the ui vitest alias, no dist leg): deleting `schema.onColumnHide?.(columnKey);` from `data-table.tsx` turned the grid pin red (1 failed | 1 passed, the CONTROL green); restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation B: deleting the `updateListedFields(...)` line of `hideColumnFromMenu` in `ListView.tsx` turned three of the four harness cases red (the "reports nothing" case stays green by construction); restored, blob == HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Work-item survey of the card against origin/main 3a81fb75 (every 「要做的」 and 验收 item): all are present except (1) this header-menu hide, built here, and (2) item 5's 「规范里为个人列布局开的口子（`columnState`）」: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` still declares `columnState: ViewColumnStateSchema.optional()` on the view item and on the list overlay. Retiring it is a `packages/spec` change, so this PR leaves it to the seat. The sign-out keep of browser layout (ruling 7064241116) is its own card, #36110, and the coordinator's untested items (kanban drafts, a second user, a mouse drag of a header) read as draft paths in code: a header drag goes `onColumnsReorder` → `ObjectGrid` column state → `onColumnStateChange` → the draft's `columnOrder`.
- A table with no host handler (any `data-table` outside a list) keeps today's behaviour: the hide lives in the table's own state.

## Verification

First read (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — `hideColumnFromMenu` and its `onColumnHide` spread on the grid: the routing through `updateListedFields`.
2. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` — `hideColumn`, the one added call.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — the prop and its forward onto `dataTableSchema`.

Two-minute check: on a Console list with a shared grid view, click a column header and pick "Hide column": the column goes and 「放弃」「保存」 appear at the right of the tab row; 「放弃」 brings the column back, and the network panel shows no write.
